title: Sensor Array Walk

story.briefing: Past the gate, the Programming District logs everything. Somewhere in this stream the signal first turns upward, and that turning point is where the fault began.
story.success: Turning point located. The district opens its records to you.

description: Given an array of readings, return the index of the first reading that is strictly greater than the reading immediately before it. Index 0 has nothing before it and can never qualify. If no reading is greater than its predecessor, return -1.

examples.explanation: 7 is greater than the 4 before it.

hints: Each element is compared against the one before it, so the comparison involves two positions at once rather than a single value.
Starting the loop at index 0 would read position -1, which does not exist. Decide where the first valid comparison actually is.
Start at index 1. As soon as readings[i] is greater than readings[i - 1], return i. If the loop finishes without returning, return -1.
